Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE

JUSTIFICATION FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION SECTION 1: IDENTIFICATION OF THE AGENCY AND THE CONTRACTING ACTIVITY

Department of State Contracting Activity ☐ Office of Acquisitions Management ☐ Foreign Service Institute ☐ Office of Foreign Missions ☐ U.S. Mission to the United Nations ☒ Overseas Post U.S. Embassy Rome, Italy Requiring Activity U.S. Embassy in Rome – GSO

SECTION 2: NATURE AND/OR DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION BEING APPROVED

Approval is requested to solicit and award, on a sole-source basis, an IDIQ contract to Queen Limousine for transportation services with drivers in support of a senior high-level USG VIP visit to Italy, as described in Section 3, on behalf of the Requiring Activity.

The authority to act under this Class Justification and Approval (J&A) expires on February 28, 2026.

This action will result in a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract.

SECTION 3: DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES/SERVICES REQUIRED TO MEET THE AGENCY’S NEEDS

The Embassy requires transportation services with drivers to support a Senior high-level USG VIP visit in connection with the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympic Games.

Services Estimated Quantity Estimated Period of Performance Transportation Services with Drivers 190 Vehicles 20 January – 15 February The estimated value for the entire period of performance is estimated at $7,584,597.43.

Task orders will be issued as required to meet operational needs and security requirements.

The contractor shall provide high-quality vehicles and drivers and operate with established, robust internal processes for financial management, quality assurance, and operational oversight to ensure all aspects of contract execution are properly monitored and controlled.

SECTION 4: IDENTIFICATION OF THE STATUTORY AUTHORITY PERMITTING OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION This acquisition is conducted under the authority of 41 USC 3304, as implemented by FAR 6.3 and substantiated by the following:

Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE ☒ FAR 6.103-2 - Unusual and compelling urgency.

SECTION 5: DEMONSTRATION THAT THE PROPOSED CONTRACTOR’S UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS OR THE NATURE OF THE ACQUISITION REQUIRES USE OF THE AUTHORITY CITED

The contractor’s unique qualifications and expertise are essential due to the scale and complexity of the event, the specific requirements to be met, and the contractor’s demonstrated experience and capacity to manage such services effectively.

This assessment is further supported by the last-minute notification of VIP travel, the stringent security and operational standards to be met, and the overall critical nature of the required services, which creates an unusual and compelling urgency.

These unique senior high-level USG VIP travel requirements result in only a single, or a very limited number of, responsible sources capable of providing the required level of operational support. The proposed contractor can meet these requirements due to a strong record of past performance on similar projects.

SECTION 6. DESCRIPTION OF EFFORTS TO ENSURE THAT OFFERS WERE SOLICITED FROM AS

MANY POTENTIAL SOURCES AS IS PRACTICABLE, INCLUDING WHETHER A NOTICE WAS OR

WILL BE PUBLICIZED AS REQUIRED BY FAR SUBPART 5.2 AND, IF NOT, WHICH EXCEPTION

UNDER FAR 5.202 APPLIES

A formal synopsis of the proposed procurement was not published on SAM.gov because this contract action is being made under the conditions described in FAR 6.103-2, which allows for exceptions due to unusual and compelling urgency. Market research identified a few other vendors; however, none demonstrated the experience or capacity to manage operational services of this scale.

SECTION 7. DETERMINATION BY THE CONTRACTING OFFICER THAT THE ANTICIPATED COST TO THE GOVERNMENT IS FAIR AND REASONABLE

The Contracting Officer has determined the anticipated cost to the Government of the services covered by this J&A will be fair and reasonable based on: o Rates from prior similar events SECTION 8. DESCRIPTION OF THE MARKET RESEARCH CONDUCTED (SEE PART 10) AND THE

RESULTS OR A STATEMENT OF THE REASON MARKET RESEARCH WAS NOT CONDUCTED

This event is attended by both official and unofficial representatives from around the world. Most services have already been secured, and costs increase significantly during this period, further limiting the number of vendors capable of meeting the Embassy’s transportation requirements.

The short notice, high demand, and security-sensitive nature of the requirement have limited the ability to conduct full and open market research.

Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE SECTION 9. ANY OTHER FACTS SUPPORTING THE USE OF OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN

COMPETITION

The unique requirements associated with senior high-level USG VIP travel, combined with security considerations and the operational environment of the event, limit the Government's ability to conduct a full and open competition.

The proposed contractor possesses unique qualifications that meet the Government's security and logistical requirements. Any delay in the award may result in the unavailability of qualified transportation resources.

SECTION 10. LISTING OF THE SOURCES, IF ANY, THAT EXPRESSED, IN WRITING, AN INTEREST

IN THE ACQUISITION

MTM Italia Srl expressed interest in providing these services. MTM Italia Srl does not, however, currently possess the experience required to support such a complex, high-profile assignment with stringent security and logistical standards.

Furthermore, due to the urgency of the requirement and the limited time available before the event, there is insufficient time to onboard and prepare a new contractor to meet the complex operational demands. Attempting to do so would pose significant risks to the successful execution of the event and could compromise both security and mission objectives.

SECTION 11. STATEMENT OF THE ACTIONS, IF ANY, THE AGENCY MAY TAKE TO REMOVE OR

OVERCOME ANY BARRIERS TO COMPETITION BEFORE ANY SUBSEQUENT ACQUISITION FOR THE SUPPLIES OR SERVICES REQUIRED

The Government recognizes the importance of fostering full and open competition for future acquisitions of similar services. The unique operational environment connected with the event, characterized by extreme demand, early block allocation, and security-driven constraints, has significantly limited the Government' s ability to conduct meaningful competition in the immediate term.

Office of the Procurement Executive U.S. DEPARTMENT of STATE
